main: Craving a hearty Bolognese but skipping the meat? This lentil version is a game-changer! Lentils mimic ground meat so well, you might not even notice the difference. No pre-soaking needed—just simmer for 15 minutes, and they thicken beautifully. Perfect for pasta, rice bowls, or even toast!
reply1:
Here's what you'll need for 3-4 servings:
• 1 cup lentils (rinsed, not soaked)
• 1 bottle (500g) tomato sauce
• 200ml water
• 1 onion, 4 cloves garlic
• 2 tbsp olive oil
• Salt, pepper
• Whole wheat pasta
reply2: Sauté chopped onion and garlic in olive oil for 5 minutes until browned for umami. Add lentils, cook 1 minute. Stir in tomato sauce and water, then simmer covered for 15 minutes.
alt_text: Whole wheat spaghetti topped with thick lentil bolognese sauce in a deep bowl, garnished with a fresh basil leaf, with a fork twirling noodles.
